card.name: The word depending after a dose range
card.fires_on: The word "depending" right after a dose or duration range, introducing what the amount depends on. Also fires on direction letters in map coordinates and on "v" in v/v ratios.

modes.label: Depending on...
modes.description: "depending" follows a range of doses, hours or days and leads into severity, dose or response.
modes.example: every 3 or 4 hours for 7 to 10 days,<< depending>> on the severity of the infection.

modes.label: Coordinates
modes.description: The compass letter N or E closes a latitude or longitude value.

modes.label: Solvent ratio
modes.description: The letter v inside a percentage v/v mixture ratio.
